name: PMG verified implementation-source intake
truth_rules: The exact GitHub commit is a preserved external source reference; it is not Reality itself.
Classification is deterministic and records its basis; it is not a fabricated probability.
Observation ingestion creates a proposal and never mutates the Current model.
Approval and application are separate server-confirmed commands.
The applied relation says TRACKS_IMPLEMENTATION_SOURCE with candidate_pr_pending_merge status; it does not claim that main is promoted.
Map, Feed, and Dashboard read the same D1 operational read model.
Layout remains projector output and is never written by this path.

acceptance_checks.requirement: The verified GitHub source creates one immutable external representation, one observation, evidence, deterministic classification, and a pending human-gated proposal.
Approval returns applied=false and the Current model remains unchanged until a separate apply command succeeds.
Apply creates a revision and bitemporal relation, advances the workspace head, and is idempotent.
Map, Feed, and Dashboard expose the same applied source relation and revision from the server read model.
The browser evidence contains the input, classification, approval, apply, navigation, DOM, console, network, and screenshot observations.
